leadLessons.symptom: A status query for the 28-take batch failed.
leadLessons.cause: creative_get_flow_run_status accepts at most 20 session_ids, absent from displayed schema.
leadLessons.fix: Query <=20 sessions at a time; never rerun paid generation.

leadLessons.symptom: Several reused prompts with soft/muted wording still produced hissy high-frequency or sub-bass-only sounds.
leadLessons.cause: Prompt adjectives do not ensure suitable generated spectra; raw QC found 90–97% >4k fishing, 140–200Hz mega, and a -56.4dBFS silent trade take.
leadLessons.fix: Keep unsuitable categories unpicked, report exact candidates, and revise only those original nodes in a separately scoped next generation; do not publish them or infer comfort from successful generation.

leadLessons.symptom: Rain ambience AAC sample peak measured -5.59 dBFS despite the -6dBFS pre-encode limiter.
leadLessons.cause: Lossy AAC reconstruction can overshoot the PCM limiter ceiling.
leadLessons.fix: Rejected that candidate; selected a lower-crest replacement, whose encoded peak is remeasured. Lead should decide whether ambience mastering needs codec headroom/post-encode peak verification.

leadLessons.symptom: Hail ambience normalized correctly but retained 94.88% energy above 4kHz.
leadLessons.cause: The new ambience path controls loudness/seam/peak but not SFX-style spectral comfort.
leadLessons.fix: User expanded scope for high-frequency hail rework. Reused original node with rounded wood/rubbery plop prompts; take9 passes raw and encoded QC. Rejected results remain in provenance.

leadLessons.symptom: Wood/bamboo/cork prompts produced some near-silent takes, and wind/sand/crunch words dominated into hiss despite no-high-pitched negatives.
leadLessons.cause: Text-to-sound does not reliably follow amplitude or material qualifiers.
leadLessons.fix: Reject silence before gain; simplify to rounded wood/leather bodies, generate only remaining failures, and measure every real take.

leadLessons.symptom: Double-knock prompt produced one or three knocks; the global peak attack also points at the second knock.
leadLessons.cause: Prompt cardinality is not guaranteed; the report measures global-peak attack, not first meaningful pulse.
leadLessons.fix: Check 10ms RMS envelopes; retain two-pulse candidates and use existing maxMs to remove an extra trailing knock. Preserve measured hitMs and temporal advisory flags.

leadLessons.symptom: Hail take6 passed spectral QC but encoded at -29.3 LUFS and -5.79 dBTP; literal ice-pellet and dense-patter prompts also produced >93% high-frequency energy.
leadLessons.cause: Semantic material words can dominate spectral adjectives; sparse isolated transient peaks make the limiter reduce body level and AAC can overshoot its PCM ceiling.
leadLessons.fix: Kept all failures in provenance, regenerated only hail, chose take9 with raw -27.2 LUFS, and verified the final AAC at -28.1 LUFS / -6.07 dBTP without changing QC limits or pipeline code.
